import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
revisions = ('4b2e30231c20d3374a39976df5a0f998a6c6f90c','d43e63c8872c4029c7edb9067d8f272642e7885a')
observations=[]
for rev in revisions:
    get=lambda p:subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{rev}:{p}'],cwd=repo)
    ns={'__name__':'measured_resolver','__file__':str(repo/'corpus/instruments/resolve.py')}
    exec(compile(get('corpus/instruments/resolve.py'),ns['__file__'],'exec'),ns)
    skill=get('SKILL.md')
    cites={m.group(1).strip().rstrip('.,;:') for line in skill.decode().splitlines() for m in ns['TOKEN'].finditer(line) if ns['is_pathlike'](m.group(1).strip().rstrip('.,;:'))}
    classes={t:ns['classify'](t,str(repo),os.path.expanduser(ns['MIRROR_ROOT']))[0] for t in cites}
    row={'revision':rev,'skill_resolves':sum(c!='GONE' for c in classes.values()),'skill_distinct':len(cites),'skill_sha256':hashlib.sha256(skill).hexdigest(),'province_sha256':hashlib.sha256(get('PROVINCE.md')).hexdigest()}
    print(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True))
    observations.append((row,classes))
assert all((o[0]['skill_resolves'],o[0]['skill_distinct'])==(32,506) for o in observations)
assert observations[0][1] == observations[1][1]
assert observations[0][0]['skill_sha256']==observations[1][0]['skill_sha256']
assert observations[0][0]['province_sha256']==observations[1][0]['province_sha256']
